source.name: Brawl Atlas · EliF77/brawlstars-ranked
source.populationDetail: Publisher ranked sample, upstream Elo 12–22; active/higher-ranked players overrepresented
source.refreshCadence: weekly publisher export; raw dataset normally twice weekly, daily early in a new season
source.unit: brawler appearances in publisher ranked-set rows
source.pickRateDenominator: all brawler appearances in the same date/rank/map/mode slice
source.outcomeHandling: Measured upstream binary win counts are reused. No synthetic wins, Bayesian adjustment, or model score is added.

limitations: Sampled community data, not all global battles.
No draft order or bans in the dataset.
Public Atlas export has no counted head-to-head or teammate outcomes. Model embeddings are deliberately ignored.
Day-level resolution cannot isolate the exact hour of a balance maintenance.
